prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='CWT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) tied with multiple models, while CWT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.861). RF dominates overall RMSE (191.3) with strong late-horizon performance (287.6). Unstable rankings (Kendall τ=-0.13) and extreme disagreement (spread=6.65) favor robust median/trimmed_mean over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
